projects.title: Cloud-Native Event-Driven ETL Pipeline
projects.subtitle: Serverless High-Throughput Ingestion & Analytics on GCP
projects.problemStatement: Traditional batch ETL systems introduce latency, fragile cron dependencies, and high idle server costs when dealing with intermittent high-volume transaction records.
projects.solutionArchitecture: Built an event-driven, fully serverless pipeline using GCP Cloud Pub/Sub for asynchronous message queuing, containerized Cloud Run services running Python ingestion workers, and Google BigQuery with partition/cluster keys for near real-time analytics. Entire infrastructure is provisioned through modular Terraform code with GitHub Actions CI/CD validation.
architectureHighlights: Decoupled Pub/Sub messaging ensures zero message loss under burst traffic
Auto-scaling Cloud Run microservices scale to zero when idle for cost-efficiency
Partitioned & Clustered BigQuery tables optimized for low-latency BI queries
Automated Terraform CI/CD pipeline validates linting, plan, and apply stages

projects.title: Distributed Data Processing Engine
projects.subtitle: High-Throughput Batch Processing with PySpark & Docker
projects.problemStatement: Processing multi-gigabyte transactional datasets using single-node scripts caused frequent out-of-memory (OOM) failures, erratic execution times, and unrecoverable pipeline states upon step failures.
projects.solutionArchitecture: Designed a distributed transformation engine leveraging PySpark on containerized worker nodes. Ingests raw data from AWS S3, applies vectorized transformations, handles data deduplication and schema validation, writes columnar Parquet data to an analytical layer, and logs audit metrics into PostgreSQL. Coordinated via Apache Airflow DAGs with retry policies.
architectureHighlights: Distributed memory computation avoiding single-node RAM bottlenecks
Columnar Parquet compression reducing storage footprint by 65%
Airflow orchestrated Directed Acyclic Graphs (DAGs) with checkpointed retries
Containerized development environment replicating production clusters

projects.title: Scalable Microservice API & Caching Layer
projects.subtitle: High-Concurrency Backend Services with Sub-Millisecond Cache
projects.problemStatement: High traffic web and analytics services encounter severe database connection exhaustion and latency spikes when serving frequently queried read-heavy data models.
projects.solutionArchitecture: Engineered an asynchronous FastAPI microservice backed by PostgreSQL with an intelligent multi-tier Redis caching layer. Implemented cache-aside pattern with TTL invalidation, connection pooling, non-blocking async DB drivers (asyncpg), and rigorous Pydantic data validation schemas.
architectureHighlights: Asynchronous event loop handling concurrent I/O requests without thread blocking
Sub-millisecond Redis response time for cache hits with automated invalidation
Clean layered architecture: Router -> Service -> Repository -> Data Model
Docker Compose orchestration with health probes and isolated networks

projects.title: Competitive Programming & Algorithmic Repository
projects.subtitle: High-Efficiency Solutions for TCS CodeVita & Advanced Challenges
projects.problemStatement: Solving complex computational challenges requiring strict algorithmic optimization within sub-second execution windows and limited memory limits under competitive contest settings.
projects.solutionArchitecture: Curated repository of optimized algorithmic solutions developed during TCS CodeVita and competitive programming training. Includes modular implementations of Dijkstra, Floyd-Warshall, Segment Trees, Trie, Fenwick Trees, Dynamic Programming (Knapsack, Bitmasking, Interval DP), and custom test harnesses for edge-case benchmarking.
architectureHighlights: Fast I/O templates in C++ and optimized generator patterns in Python
Comprehensive edge case suites and stress-test generators
Strict adherence to optimal O(V+E) graph algorithms and O(N log N) transforms
Documented proofs of correctness and asymptotic complexity analyses

responsibilities: Architected serverless and containerized data pipelines ingesting multi-source datasets into cloud analytical stores (BigQuery, PostgreSQL).
Automated cloud infrastructure deployment on GCP and AWS using modular Terraform scripts, slashing deployment setup friction by 90%.
Built asynchronous high-throughput REST APIs with FastAPI, incorporating Redis cache-aside patterns and connection pooling.
Created CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions for automated linting, test suites, container building, and deployment.
